MCP Protocol

Model Context Protocol implementation for OpenAPI CLI.

Overview

OpenAPI CLI implements MCP (Model Context Protocol) to enable seamless integration with AI assistants like Claude, providing structured access to OpenAPI-specified APIs as AI tools and resources.

Getting Started

Running the MCP Server

# Start MCP server with stdio transport (default)
openapi-cli mcp-server --spec openapi.yaml

# Start with HTTP transport for debugging
openapi-cli mcp-server --spec openapi.yaml --port 8080

Claude Desktop Configuration

Configure in Claude Desktop settings:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "openapi-cli": {
      "command": "openapi-cli",
      "args": [
        "mcp-server",
        "--spec", "/path/to/openapi.yaml",
        "--base-url", "https://api.example.com/v1"
      ]
    }
  }
}

Manual Testing

Test MCP server manually:

{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "initialize",
  "params": {
    "protocolVersion": "2024-11-05",
    "capabilities": {
      "roots": {},
      "sampling": {},
      "tools": {}
    },
    "clientInfo": {
      "name": "test-client",
      "version": "1.0.0"
    }
  },
  "id": 1
} | openapi-cli mcp-server --spec openapi.yaml

Server Capabilities

The MCP server advertises these capabilities:

{
  "protocolVersion": "2024-11-05",
  "capabilities": {
    "roots": {
      "listChanged": true
    },
    "sampling": {},
    "tools": {
      "listChanged": true
    }
  },
  "serverInfo": {
    "name": "openapi-cli",
    "version": "1.0.0"
  }
}

Tools (Methods)

Tool Generation from OpenAPI Spec

OpenAPI CLI automatically generates MCP tools from your OpenAPI specification. Each endpoint becomes a tool.

Tool Naming Convention

Tools are named using the pattern: <tag>_<operationId> or <path>_<method> if no operationId.

Examples: - pet_find - GET /pet - pet_add - POST /pet - store_inventory - GET /store/inventory

Tool Schema

Each tool provides full JSON Schema for input validation:

{
  "name": "pet_findById",
  "description": "Find pet by ID. Returns a single pet.",
  "inputSchema": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "petId": {
        "type": "integer",
        "description": "ID of pet to return",
        "minimum": 1,
        "required": true
      }
    },
    "additionalProperties": false,
    "required": ["petId"]
  }
}

tools/list

List all available tools (API endpoints).

Request:

{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "tools/list",
  "id": 1
}

Response:

{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "tools": [
      {
        "name": "pet_add",
        "description": "Add a new pet to the store",
        "inputSchema": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "name": {"type": "string"},
            "status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["available", "pending", "sold"]}
          }
        }
      },
      {
        "name": "pet_findById",
        "description": "Find pet by ID",
        "inputSchema": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "petId": {"type": "integer"}
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}

tools/call

Execute an API endpoint tool.

Request:

{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "tools/call",
  "id": 1,
  "params": {
    "name": "pet_findById",
    "arguments": {
      "petId": 1
    }
  }
}

Response:

{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "content": [
      {
        "type": "resource",
        "resource": {
          "uri": "mcp://openapi-cli/pet/1"
        }
      },
      {
        "type": "text",
        "text": "Found pet with ID 1"
      }
    ]
  }
}

Error Response:

{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "error": {
    "code": -32603,
    "message": "Pet not found",
    "data": {
      "statusCode": 404,
      "details": {}
    }
  }
}

Resources (Data Access)

Resource URIs

Resources are identified using URIs following the pattern:

mcp://openapi-cli/<path>#<fragment>

Examples: - mcp://openapi-cli/paths//pet/~1{petId}/get - GET /pet/{petId} - mcp://openapi-cli/components/schemas/Pet - Pet schema

resources/list

List available OpenAPI specification resources.

Request:

{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "resources/list",
  "id": 1
}

Response:

{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "resources": [
      {
        "uri": "mcp://openapi-cli/openapi.yaml",
        "name": "OpenAPI Specification",
        "description": "Complete OpenAPI 3.0 specification",
        "mimeType": "application/x-yaml"
      },
      {
        "uri": "mcp://openapi-cli/paths//pet/~1{petId}/get",
        "name": "Pet: Find by ID",
        "description": "GET /pet/{petId} endpoint",
        "mimeType": "text/plain"
      }
    ]
  }
}

resources/read

Read a resource (OpenAPI specification or metadata).

Request:

{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "resources/read",
  "params": {
    "uri": "mcp://openapi-cli/openapi.yaml"
  },
  "id": 1
}

Response:

{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "contents": [
      {
        "uri": "mcp://openapi-cli/openapi.yaml",
        "mimeType": "application/x-yaml",
        "text": "openapi: 3.0.3\ninfo:\n  title: PetStore API\n..."
      }
    ]
  }
}

resources/list_changed

Check for specification changes since last request.

Response:

{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "resources": []  // Empty list means no changes
  }
}

Authentication

MCP Auth Flow

The MCP server supports authentication via configuration:

openapi-cli mcp-server --spec openapi.yaml \
  --auth.type oauth2 \
  --auth.token your-access-token

Config file approach:

mcp:
  auth:
    type: oauth2
    token: ${OAUTH_TOKEN}

Error Handling

Standard Errors

Code Message
-32700 Parse error
-32600 Invalid Request
-32601 Method not found
-32602 Invalid params
-32603 Internal error
-32604 Not found

Application-Specific Errors

Tool Error Example:

{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "error": {
    "code": -32603,
    "message": "API request failed",
    "data": {
      "httpStatus": 500,
      "httpMessage": "Internal Server Error",
      "details": {
        "error": "Database connection failed"
      }
    }
  }
}

Lifecycle Methods

initialize

Initialize MCP connection:

{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "initialize",
  "params": {
    "protocolVersion": "2024-11-05",
    "capabilities": {},
    "clientInfo": {
      "name": "claude",
      "version": "1.0.0"
    }
  },
  "id": 1
}

initialized

Acknowledge initialization:

{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "initialized"
}

shutdown

Graceful shutdown:

{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "shutdown",
  "id": 1
}

Advanced Configuration

Custom Tool Generation

Control tool naming and descriptions:

mcp:
  tools:
    naming:
      style: operation_id  # operation_id or path_method
      prefix: ""          # Optional prefix
    descriptions:
      include_parameters: true
      include_response: true

Resource Filtering

Control which resources are exposed:

mcp:
  resources:
    include:
      - paths**
      - components/schemas**
    exclude:
      - paths/**/internal/**

Rate Limiting

Prevent API abuse through MCP:

mcp:
  rate_limit:
    enabled: true
    requests_per_minute: 60
    burst: 10

Examples

Example 1: Complete Workflow

# Start MCP server
openapi-cli mcp-server --spec openapi.yaml

# Client workflow:
# 1. Initialize
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "initialize",
  "params": {"protocolVersion": "2024-11-05"},
  "id": 1
}

# 2. List tools
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "tools/list",
  "id": 2
}

# 3. Call tool
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "pet_findById",
    "arguments": {"petId": 1}
  },
  "id": 3
}

Example 2: Error Handling

# Invalid tool name
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "invalid_tool",
    "arguments": {}
  },
  "id": 1
}

# Response:
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "error": {
    "code": -32601,
    "message": "Tool 'invalid_tool' not found"
  }
}

Example 3: Resource Reading

# Read OpenAPI spec
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "resources/read",
  "params": {
    "uri": "mcp://openapi-cli/openapi.yaml"
  },
  "id": 1
}

# Response:
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "contents": [
      {
        "uri": "mcp://openapi-cli/openapi.yaml",
        "mimeType": "application/x-yaml",
        "text": "openapi: 3.0.3\n..."
      }
    ]
  }
}

Security Considerations

  1. Authentication: Always use proper authentication
  2. Environment Variables: Store secrets in environment variables
  3. Rate Limiting: Enable for production deployments
  4. Input Validation: Schema validation is enforced automatically
  5. Sanitization: Remove sensitive fields from responses

Testing

Unit Testing Tools

# Test: tools/list
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "tools/list",
  "id": 1
}

# Verify response contains expected tools

Integration Testing

# Full MCP integration test
openapi-cli mcp-server --spec test-openapi.yaml --port 8080

# Send requests via HTTP or stdio
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080 \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"tools/list","id":1}'

Troubleshooting

Common Issues

Issue: "Specification not found"

Solution: Check spec path and file permissions:

openapi-cli mcp-server --spec /full/path/to/openapi.yaml

Issue: "Tool 'xxx' not found"

Solution: Verify the tool name matches the operation or path:

openapi-cli inventory list openapi.yaml  # See available tools

Debug Mode

Enable debug logging:

openapi-cli --debug mcp-server --spec openapi.yaml
